name: firestorm-avatar
description: Skills + MCP connection to drive the user's Second Life avatar through the embedded Firestorm MCP server: movement (teleport/sit/stand), vision (viewport snapshot), inventory, appearance, profiles, search, groups, 1:1 IM, offers/dialog responses, object touch, uploads, nearby-avatar inspection, bridge-mediated in-world chat / RLV relays, and guarded L$ payments. Requires the ID-fork Firestorm build with IDMCPServerEnabled.
